notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for receive-order multi-attribute update callback cancellation. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, multi-attribute FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies ordinary multi-attribute publication, registration, per-recipient projection, queued reflection withdrawal before HLA_EVOKED callback servicing, immediate-model delivery boundaries, later-update suppression, and standard federation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador multi-attribute publication, registration, ordinary update, and subscription withdrawal with FederateAmbassador discovery and receive-order reflection callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador attribute-update and FederateAmbassador reflection declarations
